title: INVOICE by square
description: Canonical PascalCase JSON representation of an Invoice document from spec/bysquare.xsd (by-square type 1, version 0). Decimal values are lossless canonical strings.
$comment: Properties marked readOnly are bsqr:computed=true. They may be returned by an explicit calculation API but are not transported in the QR sequence. Every bsqr:maxLength annotation is advisory and is recorded in descriptions instead of a rejecting JSON maxLength keyword.

InvoiceID.description: Unique invoice identifier. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.

IssueDate.description: Invoice issue date. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 8.

TaxPointDate.description: Tax point or delivery date. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 8.

OrderID.description: Primary order identifier. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.

DeliveryNoteID.description: Primary delivery-note identifier. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.

LocalCurrencyCode.description: Local ISO 4217 currency. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 3.

ForeignCurrencyCode.description: Foreign ISO 4217 currency. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 3; all invoice amounts then use this currency.

CurrRate.description: Direct foreign-to-local exchange rate. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 15.

ReferenceCurrRate.description: Reference local-to-foreign exchange rate. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 15.

NumberOfInvoiceLines.description: Invoice line count; zero denotes a header-only invoice. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 11.

InvoiceDescription.description: General description for a multi-line or header-only invoice. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 30.

DocumentType.description: Semantic document type. XML represents the same value as xsi:type; header classifiers are 0 through 4 in this order.

Decimal.description: Lossless canonical XSD decimal string: no plus sign, exponent, redundant leading zeroes, trailing fractional zeroes, or negative zero. Individual QR fields carrying decimals have an advisory bsqr:maxLength of 15.

Percentage.description: Canonical VAT rate in the hard XSD range [0,1], for example 0.2 for 20%. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 15.

Date.description: Canonical ISO 8601 calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

PaymentMeans.pattern: ^(?:moneyTransfer(?: cash)?(?: cashOnDelivery)?(?: creditCard)?(?: advance)?(?: mutualOffset)?(?: other)?|cash(?: cashOnDelivery)?(?: creditCard)?(?: advance)?(?: mutualOffset)?(?: other)?|cashOnDelivery(?: creditCard)?(?: advance)?(?: mutualOffset)?(?: other)?|creditCard(?: advance)?(?: mutualOffset)?(?: other)?|advance(?: mutualOffset)?(?: other)?|mutualOffset(?: other)?|other)$
PaymentMeans.description: One or more XSD PaymentMean enum values, space-separated in canonical classifier order. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 3 for the encoded bit classifier.

CompanyTaxID.description: Supplier tax ID. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 12.

CompanyVATID.description: Supplier VAT ID. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 14.

CompanyRegisterID.description: Supplier company-register ID. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 14.

CompanyTaxID.description: Customer tax ID. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 12.

CompanyVATID.description: Customer VAT ID. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 14.

CompanyRegisterID.description: Customer company-register ID. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 14.

PartyIdentification.description: Customer identifier in the supplier's accounting system. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 20.

State.description: State within a federation. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 10.

Name.description: Contact person or department. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 20.

ItemName.description: Item name or description. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 30.

ItemEANCode.description: Item EAN code. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 30.

UnitPriceTaxExclusiveAmount.description: Computed as MonetarySummary TaxExclusiveAmount divided by InvoicedQuantity; not transported.

UnitPriceTaxInclusiveAmount.description: Computed as MonetarySummary TaxInclusiveAmount divided by InvoicedQuantity; not transported.

UnitPriceTaxAmount.description: Computed as MonetarySummary TaxAmount divided by InvoicedQuantity; not transported.

TaxInclusiveAmount.description: Computed as TaxExclusiveAmount plus TaxAmount; not transported.

AlreadyClaimedTaxExclusiveAmount.description: Already-claimed tax-exclusive deposit amount. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 15.

AlreadyClaimedTaxInclusiveAmount.description: Computed as AlreadyClaimedTaxExclusiveAmount plus AlreadyClaimedTaxAmount; not transported.

AlreadyClaimedTaxAmount.description: VAT on already-claimed deposits. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 15.

TaxExclusiveAmount.description: Computed sum of category TaxExclusiveAmount values; not transported.

TaxInclusiveAmount.description: Computed sum of category TaxInclusiveAmount values; not transported.

TaxAmount.description: Computed sum of category TaxAmount values; not transported.

AlreadyClaimedTaxExclusiveAmount.description: Computed sum of category AlreadyClaimedTaxExclusiveAmount values; not transported.

AlreadyClaimedTaxInclusiveAmount.description: Computed sum of category AlreadyClaimedTaxInclusiveAmount values; not transported.

AlreadyClaimedTaxAmount.description: Computed sum of category AlreadyClaimedTaxAmount values; not transported.

DifferenceTaxExclusiveAmount.description: Computed sum of category DifferenceTaxExclusiveAmount values; not transported.

DifferenceTaxInclusiveAmount.description: Computed sum of category DifferenceTaxInclusiveAmount values; not transported.

DifferenceTaxAmount.description: Computed sum of category DifferenceTaxAmount values; not transported.

PayableRoundingAmount.description: Rounding adjustment added to the payable amount. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 15.

PaidDepositsAmount.description: Paid untaxed deposits. Advisory QR-sequence bsqr:maxLength: 15.

PayableAmount.description: Computed as DifferenceTaxInclusiveAmount minus PaidDepositsAmount plus PayableRoundingAmount; not transported.
